style: Luxury DC-area design-build, white and bronze with photo-led tiles

Project-type photo tiles with a thin inset white keyline frame and an italic adjective over a bold label ('luxury Kitchens', 'masterful Bathrooms', 'exquisite Additions')
Header utility row with phone number plus a solid bronze 'GET IN TOUCH' block above the main nav
Mobile header that keeps a bronze 'GET IN TOUCH' button centered between the logo mark and the hamburger

'Take the 5 steps to success' process teaser button
